_provenance: GestureWheel beat script for radial social verb menu. Exercises UGestureWheel functionality: TAB-hold to open wheel, release to commit gesture, seven social verbs (Wave, Offer, Refuse, Point, Kneel, Beckon, Thank). HISTORY (tb-0185, sub-43, 2026-07-18): both log_contains expects here failed 4x across prior sessions and were flagged by beat_lint as a SETTLED WALL, documented elsewhere as 'FAIL honestly until TAB is wired' -- that diagnosis was WRONG. TAB was always wired (Config/DefaultInput.ini DemoGestureWheel->Tab; DemoPlayerController::OnTabPressed/OnTabReleased call GestureWheelWidget->OpenWheel()/CommitGesture(), which emit these exact strings). The true root cause was structural and lived in the WITNESS layer, not this feature: core/witness.py's Witness.drain_demobeats() filtered the log tail to [DEMOBEAT]-only lines BEFORE sleepwalker._check_expect ever saw it, so log_contains could never match a non-[DEMOBEAT] marker no matter what the engine did -- every H-21 witness marker convention ([GestureWheel], [Weather], [Memorial], [Sacrifice], [Footstep], and [NPCTrade] in social_trade.beats.json) was equally, structurally inaudible. FIXED by adding Witness.drain_all_new() (a superset of drain_demobeats()'s filtered return, sharing its single bounded offset-cursor read -- DEMOBEAT behavior stays byte-identical) and pointing sleepwalker's log_contains check at it instead. PROVEN live in PIE both directions in one beat/window (scratchpad probe, simtest_649bbf306ebf266a): '[GestureWheel] OpenWheel' -> ok=true log_hit=True; a guaranteed-absent control string -> ok=false log_hit=False. This exact file then re-run clean: simtest_20b56df681eb48c8, 2/2 beats reached, 'Clean walk.' beat_lint now reports 'ok' with zero SETTLED/WALL flags (was 2 before the fix).
